svg.title: play-with-containers architecture
svg.desc: A client reaches api-gateway-app through host port 3000, the only published port. Inside the crud-net bridge network the gateway proxies movie requests over HTTP to inventory-app, which stores them in inventory-db, and publishes billing messages to rabbit-queue, which delivers them to billing-app; billing-app inserts them into billing-db and acknowledges after the commit. Named volumes hold inventory-db and billing-db data and the gateway logs.
svg.text: CRUD-NET · BRIDGE · DNS BY SERVICE NAME
A gateway publishes, answers 200 at once
B broker delivers C insert into orders
